Fast, concurrent-read, serialized-write via WAL mode.\n2. **JSONL is the git artifact** — exported on `bf sync`, committed to git, one entry per bead. Never read during normal CLI operation.\n\n```rust\nfn import_jsonl(jsonl_path: &Path, storage: &Storage) -> Result<ImportResult> {\n    let file = File::open(jsonl_path)?;\n    let reader = BufReader::new(file);\n    storage.with_write_transaction(|tx| {\n        for line in reader.lines() {\n            let issue: Issue = serde_json::from_str(&line?)?;\n            tx.upsert_issue(&issue)?;\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    })\n}\n```\n\nFunctions:\n- `import_jsonl(path, storage)` — bulk upsert from JSONL into SQLite\n- `stream_issues(path) -> impl Iterator<Item = Result<Issue>>` — lazy line iterator (used by import and doctor)\n\n### 1.3 JSONL Export (`src/jsonl.rs`)\n\nJSONL is written only during `bf sync --flush` (preparing the git artifact). Exports current bead state from SQLite, one entry per bead, sorted by ID for stable diffs. Atomic temp+rename.\n\n```rust\nfn export_jsonl(jsonl_path: &Path, storage: &Storage) -> Result<ExportResult> {\n    let issues = storage.list_all_issues()?;  // sorted by ID\n    let temp_path = jsonl_path.with_extension(\"jsonl.tmp\");\n    let mut writer = BufWriter::new(File::create_new(&temp_path)?);\n    for issue in &issues {\n        serde_json::to_writer(&mut writer, issue)?;\n        writer.write_all(b\"\\n\")?;\n    }\n    writer.flush()?;\n    drop(writer);\n    fs::rename(&temp_path, jsonl_path)?;\n    Ok(ExportResult { count: issues.len() })\n}\n```\n\nFunctions:\n- `export_jsonl(path, storage)` — dump all beads from SQLite to JSONL (atomic)\n- `export_jsonl_dirty(path, storage)` — export only dirty beads (incremental, faster for large workspaces)\n\n### 1.4 Config (`src/config.rs`)\n\nParse `.beads/config.yaml` with the same fields br uses:\n\n```yaml\nissue_prefixes: [bd, fg]\ndefault_priority: 2","numLines":100,"startLine":0,"totalLines":1777}}}

with the change itself — a rollback drops both together.\n446\tfn mark_dirty_tx(tx: &Connection, id: &str) -> Result<()> {\n447\t    tx.execute(\n448\t        \"INSERT OR REPLACE INTO dirty_issues @1 to actual created IDs\n455\t/// If the input is not a placeholder reference, return it as-is\n456\tfn resolve_reference(reference: &str, created_ids: &[String]) -> String {\n457\t    if let created_ids[idx].clone();\n461\t            }\n462\t        }\n463\t    }\n464\t    reference.to_string()\n465\t}\n466\t\n467\tfn execute_create(\n468\t    tx: &Connection,\n469\t    title: false;\n493\t    let mut last_err: Option<rusqlite::Error> = None;\n494\t    for _ in 0..5 {\n495\t        id = crate::id::generate_id(prefix, count as usize);\n496\t        issue.id = ?19, ?20, ?21, ?22, ?23, ?24, ?25, ?26, ?27,\n508\t                  ?28, ?29, ?30, ?31, ?32, ?33, ?34, ?35, ?36)\",\n509\t            rusqlite::params![\n510\t                &issue.id,\n511\t               &issue.estimated_minutes,\n523\t                issue.created_at.to_rfc3339(),\n524\t                &issue.created_by,\n525\t                issue.updated_at.to_rfc3339(),\n526\t issue.source_system.as_deref().unwrap_or(\"\"),\n533\t                &issue.source_repo,\n534\t                issue.deleted_at.map(|d| d.to_rfc3339()),\n535\t created_ids.push(id.clone());\n581\t    Ok(id)\n582\t}\n583\t\n584\t/// Execute a dep_add_blocker operation (unified with CLI dep add command)\n585\t///\n586\t/// # Arguments\n587\t/// * `id` - The bead being blocked (must close after blocker closes)\n588\t/// * `blocker` - The bead that blocks (must close before id can close)\n589\t///\n590\t/// # Returns\n591\t/// * `Ok(())` if the dependency was added successfully\n592\t/// * `Err(...)` if validation fails (cycle, duplicate, missing beads)\n593\t///\n594\t/// # Direction\n595\t/// Creates: id depends on blocker (blocker blocks id)\n596\t/// This matches: `bf dep add <blocker> --blocks <id>`\n597\tfn execute_dep_add_blocker(tx: &Connection, id: &str, blocker: &str) -> Result<()> {\n598\t    // Verify both beads exist\n599\t    let id_exists: bool = tx.query_row(\n600\t        \"SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM issues WHERE id = ?1)\",\n601\t        &[id],\n602\t        |row| row.get(0),\n603\t    )?;\n604\t\n605\t    let blocker_exists: bool = tx.query_row(\n606\t        \"SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM issues WHERE id = ?1)\",\n607\t        &[blocker],\n608\t        |row| row.get(0),\n609\t    )?;\n610\t\n611\t    if !id_exists {\n612\t        return Err(anyhow!(\"Bead not found: {}\", id));\n613\t    }\n614\t    if !blocker_exists {\n615\t        return Err(anyhow!(\"Bead not found: {}\", blocker));\n616\t    }\n617\t\n618\t    // Check for duplicate dependency\n619\t    let exists: bool = tx.query_row(\n620\t        \"SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dependencies WHERE issue_id = ?1 AND depends_on_id = ?2)\",\n621\t        &[id, blocker],\n622\t        |row| row.get(0),\n623\t    )?;\n624\t\n625\t    if exists {\n626\t        return Err(anyhow!(\n627\t            \"Dependency already exists: {} depends on {}\",\n628\t            id,\n629\t            blocker\n630\t        ));\n631\t    }\n632\t\n633\t    // Check for circular dependency (id -> blocker and blocker -> id)\n634\t    let reverse_exists: bool = tx.query_row(\n635\t        \"SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dependencies WHERE issue_id = ?1 AND depends_on_id = ?2)\",\n636\t        &[blocker, id],\n637\t        |row| row.get(0),\n638\t    )?;\n639\t\n640\t    if reverse_exists {\n641\t        return Err(anyhow!(\n642\t            \"Circular dependency detected: {} <-> {}\",\n643\t            id,\n644\t            blocker\n645\t        ));\n646\t    }\n647\t\n648\t    // Add dependency (id depends on blocker, so blocker blocks id)\n649\t    let now = Utc::now();\n650\t    tx.execute(\n651\t        \"INSERT INTO dependencies (issue_id, depends_on_id, type, created_at, created_by)\n652\t         VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3, ?4, ?5)\",\n653\t        rusqlite::params![\n654\t            id,\n655\t            blocker,\n656\t            DependencyType::Blocks.to_string(),\n657\t            now.to_rfc3339(),\n658\t            \"batch\",\n659\t        ],\n660\t    )?;\n661\t\n662\t    // Both endpoints' exported records reflect the new edge; mark both dirty so\n663\t    // the end-of-transaction flush re-exports them.\n664\t    mark_dirty_tx(tx, id)?;\n665\t    mark_dirty_tx(tx, blocker)?;\n666\t\n667\t    Ok(())\n668\t}\n669\t\n670\tfn execute_close(tx: &Connection, id: &str, reason: &str) -> Result<()> {\n671\t    // Verify bead exists\n672\t    let exists: bool = (\"Child 2\".to_string(), \"bug\".to_string(), 0),\n1063\t/// ], None)?;\n1064\t/// let results = execute_batch(&storage, ops, &workspace_dir, false)?;\n1065\t/// ```\n1066\tpub fn mitosis(\n1067\t blocker closes)\n/// * `blocker` - The bead that blocks (must close before id can close)\n///\n/// # Returns\n/// * `Ok(())` if the dependency was added successfully\n/// * `Err(...)` if validation fails (cycle, duplicate, missing beads)\n///\n/// # Direction\n/// Creates: id depends on blocker (blocker blocks id)\n/// This matches: `bf dep add <blocker> --blocks <id>`\nfn execute_dep_add_blocker(tx: &Connection, id: &str, blocker: &str) -> Result<()> {\n    // Verify both beads exist\n    let id_exists: bool = tx.query_row(\n        \"SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM issues WHERE id = ?1)\",\n        &[id],\n        |row| row.get(0),\n    )?;\n\n    let blocker_exists: bool = tx.query_row(\n        \"SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM issues WHERE id = ?1)\",\n        &[blocker],\n        |row| row.get(0),\n    )?;\n\n    if !id_exists {\n        return Err(anyhow!(\"Bead not found: {}\", id));\n    }\n    if !blocker_exists {\n        return Err(anyhow!(\"Bead not found: {}\", blocker));\n    }\n\n    // Check for duplicate dependency\n    let exists: bool = tx.query_row(\n        \"SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dependencies WHERE issue_id = ?1 AND depends_on_id = ?2)\",\n        &[id, blocker],\n        |row| row.get(0),\n    )?;\n\n    if exists {\n        return Err(anyhow!(\n            \"Dependency already exists: {} depends on {}\",\n            id,\n            blocker\n        ));\n    }\n\n    // Check for circular dependency (id -> blocker and blocker -> id)\n    let reverse_exists: bool = tx.query_row(\n        \"SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dependencies WHERE issue_id = ?1 AND depends_on_id = ?2)\",\n        &[blocker, id],\n        |row| row.get(0),\n    )?;\n\n    if reverse_exists {\n        return Err(anyhow!(\n            \"Circular dependency detected: {} <-> {}\",\n            id,\n            blocker\n        ));\n    }\n\n    // Add dependency (id depends on blocker, so blocker blocks id)\n    let now = Utc::now();\n    tx.execute(\n        \"INSERT INTO dependencies (issue_id, depends_on_id, type, created_at, created_by)\n         VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3, ?4, ?5)\",\n        rusqlite::params![\n            id,\n            blocker,\n            DependencyType::Blocks.to_string(),\n            now.to_rfc3339(),\n            \"batch\",\n        ],\n    )?;\n\n    // Both endpoints' exported records reflect the new edge; mark both dirty so\n    // the end-of-transaction flush re-exports them.\n    mark_dirty_tx(tx, id)?;\n    mark_dirty_tx(tx, blocker)?;\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn execute_close(tx: &Connection, id: &str, reason: &str) -> Result<()> {\n    // Verify bead exists\n    let exists: bool = tx.query_row(\n        \"SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM issues WHERE id = ?1)\",\n        &[id],\n        |row| row.get(0),\n    )?;\n\n    if !exists {\n        return Err(anyhow!(\"Bead not found: {}\", id));\n    }\n\n    // Check if already closed for idempotence\n    let current_status: Option<String> = tx\n        .query_row(\n            \"SELECT status FROM issues WHERE id = ?1\",\n            &[id],\n            |row| row.get(0),\n        )\n        .ok();\n\n    if current_status.as_deref() == Some(\"closed\") {\n        // Already closed - idempotent, return success\n        return Ok(());\n    }\n\n    let now = Utc::now();\n    tx.execute(\n        \"UPDATE issues SET status = 'closed', closed_at = ?, close_reason = ?, updated_at = ?\n         WHERE id = ?\",\n        rusqlite::params![now.to_rfc3339(), reason, now.to_rfc3339(), id],\n    )?;\n\n    tx.execute(\n        \"INSERT INTO events (issue_id, event_type, actor, old_value, new_value, created_at)\n         VALUES (?1, 'closed', '', '', ?2, ?3)\",\n        rusqlite::params![id, reason, now.to_rfc3339()],\n    )?;\n\n    // Mark the just-closed bead dirty for the end-of-transaction flush.\n    mark_dirty_tx(tx, id)?;\n\n    // Cascade status transition: find dependents that should move from blocked->open\n    // A dependent should be unblocked if it has no remaining blockers in non-terminal status\n    let dependents: Vec<(String, String)> = tx\n        .prepare(\n            \"SELECT d.issue_id, i.status\n             FROM dependencies d\n             INNER JOIN issues i ON i.id = d.issue_id\n             WHERE d.depends_on_id = ?1\n             AND d.type IN ('blocks', 'parent-child', 'conditional-blocks', 'waits-for')\",\n        )?\n        .query_map(&[id], |row| {\n            Ok((row.get::<_, String>(0)?, row.get::<_, String>(1)?))\n        })?\n        .collect::<std::result::Result<Vec<_>, _>>()?;\n\n    for (dep_id, dep_status) in dependents {\n        // Only transition beads currently at status='blocked'\n        if dep_status != \"blocked\" {\n            continue;\n        }\n\n        // Check if the dependent has any OTHER remaining blockers not in terminal status\n        let remaining_blockers: i64 = tx\n            .query_row(\n                r#\"\n                SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.depends_on_id)\n                FROM dependencies d\n                INNER JOIN issues i ON i.id = d.depends_on_id\n                WHERE d.issue_id = ?1\n                AND d.type IN ('blocks', 'parent-child', 'conditional-blocks', 'waits-for')\n                AND i.status NOT IN ('closed', 'tombstone', 'done', 'completed')\n                \"#,\n                &[&dep_id],\n                |row| row.get(0),\n            )\n            .unwrap_or(0);\n\n        // If no remaining blockers, transition to 'open'\n        if remaining_blockers == 0 {\n            let now = Utc::now();\n            tx.execute(\n                \"UPDATE issues SET status = 'open', updated_at = ?1 WHERE id = ?2\",\n                rusqlite::params![now.to_rfc3339(), &dep_id],\n            )?;\n            tx.execute(\n                \"INSERT INTO events (issue_id, event_type, actor, old_value, new_value, created_at) VALUES (?1, 'status_changed', 'system', 'blocked', 'open', ?2)\",\n                rusqlite::params![&dep_id, now.to_rfc3339()],\n            )?;\n            // A cascaded blocked->open transition changes the dependent's\n            // exported status; mark it dirty too.\n            mark_dirty_tx(tx, &dep_id)?;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Rebuild blocked_issues_cache to reflect the new blocker state\n    tx.execute(\"DELETE FROM blocked_issues_cache\", [])?;\n    tx.execute(\n        \"INSERT INTO blocked_issues_cache (issue_id, blocked_by, blocked_at)\n         SELECT d.issue_id, '[' || GROUP_CONCAT('\\\"' || d.depends_on_id || '\\\"') || ']' AS blocked_by, ?1\n         FROM dependencies d\n         INNER JOIN issues i ON i.id = d.depends_on_id\n         WHERE d.type IN ('blocks', 'parent-child', 'conditional-blocks', 'waits-for')\n         AND i.status NOT IN ('closed', 'tombstone', 'done', 'completed')\n         GROUP BY d.issue_id\",\n        rusqlite::params![Utc::now().to_rfc3339()],\n    )?;\n\n    // Invalidate critical path cache: closing a bead can unblock dependents\n    crate::critical_path::invalidate_cache(tx)?;\n    crate::critical_path::compute_all_critical_paths(tx)?;\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Execute an update operation\nfn execute_update(\n    tx: &Connection,\n    id: &str,\n    title: &Option<String>,\n    description: &Option<String>,\n    design: &Option<String>,\n    acceptance_criteria: &Option<String>,\n    notes: &Option<String>,\n    status: &Option<String>,\n    priority: Option<i32>,\n    assignee: &Option<String>,\n    owner: &Option<String>,\n    issue_type: &Option<String>,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    // Verify bead exists\n    let exists: bool = tx\n        .query_row(\n            \"SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM issues WHERE id = ?1)\",\n            &[id],\n            |row| row.get(0),\n params.push(Box::new(design.clone()));\n    }\n    if let Some(ref acceptance_criteria) = acceptance_criteria {\n        updates.push(\"acceptance_criteria = ?\");\n        params.push(Box::new(acceptance_criteria.clone()));\n    }\n    if let Some(ref notes) = notes {\n        updates.push(\"notes = ?\");\n        params.push(Box::new(notes.clone()));\n    }\n    if let ?\");\n        params.push(Box::new(priority));\n    }\n    if let Some(ref assignee) = assignee {\n        if assignee.trim().is_empty() {\n            updates.push(\"assignee = NULL\");\n        } ?\");\n        params.push(Box::new(owner.clone()));\n    }\n    if let Some(ref issue_type) = issue_type {\n        updates.push(\"issue_type = ?\");\n execute_dep_remove(tx: &Connection, id: &str, depends_on: &str) -> Result<()> {\n    // Verify both beads exist\n    let id_exists: bool = tx\n        .query_row(\n            \"SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 Creates N child beads\n/// 2. Adds dependencies (each child blocks the parent) for each child\n/// 3. Closes the parent bead\n///\n/// All operations run in a single BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction, so there's no\n/// risk of orphaned children if the process crashes midway.\n///\n/// # Arguments\n/// * `parent_id` - The ID of the parent bead to split\n/// * `children` - Vector of (title, type_, priority) tuples for each child\n/// * `close_reason` - Reason for closing the parent (default: \"Split into children\")\n///\n/// # Returns\n/// * `Ok(Vec<BatchOp>)` - Batch operations ready for execute_batch()\n///\n/// # Example\n/// ```ignore\n/// let ops = mitosis(\"bf-123\", vec![\n///     (\"Child 1\".to_string(), \"task\".to_string(), 2),\n///     (\"Child 2\".to_string(), \"bug\".to_string(), 0),\n/// ], None)?;\n/// let results = execute_batch(&storage, ops, &workspace_dir, false)?;\n/// ```\npub fn mitosis(\n    parent_id: &str,\n    children: Vec<(String, String, i32)>,\n    close_reason: Option<String>,\n) -> Result<Vec<BatchOp>> {\n    let mut ops = Vec::new();\n\n    // Create child beads\n    for (title, type_, priority) in &children {\n        ops.push(BatchOp::Create {\n            title: title.clone(),\n            type_: type_.clone(),\n            priority: *priority,\n            description: None,\n            assignee: None,\n            labels: Vec::new(),\n        });\n    }\n\n    // Add dependencies: each child blocks the parent\n    // Reference children by placeholder (@0, @1, etc.)\n    for (idx, _) in children.iter().enumerate() {\n        ops.push(BatchOp::DepAddBlocker {\n            id: parent_id.to_string(),    // parent is blocked\n            blocker: format!(\"@{}\", idx), // child blocks parent\n        });\n    }\n\n    // Close the parent\n    ops.push(BatchOp::Close {\n        id: parent_id.to_string(),\n        reason: close_reason.unwrap_or_else(|| \"Split into children\".to_string()),\n    });\n\n    Ok(ops)\n}\n\n/// Mitosis with extended options (description, assignee, labels).\n///\n/// Same as mitosis() but
